main_text.p: Privilegiis gaudent, quæ omnibꝰ sanctis sunt communia ; videlicet, liberatione à peccato, morte, maledictione & Satanâ: ut cętera omittā.

Præterea illarum ortum si inquiras ; reperies eas verè à Christi apostolis esse fundatas, atq; in hunc usque diem singulari Dei ꝓvidentiâ conservatas: consule annales, historias Græcas & Latinas : inspice veterū monumenta, ritus, cærimonias, quicquid demum aliquid antiquitatis refert: invenies, inde à passione Christi eas quovis tempore per oēs ætatum gradus exstitisse ; ut veteris populi conditionem omittam.

Si progressum: Illæ sub uno capite Jesu Christo, præter quod aliud excogitari nec potest nec debet, unam eandemque fidem constanter retinuerunt, & per Græciam, Italiâ, Germaniam, Galliam, Angliam, Hispaniam, imò per totum terrarum orbem, sunt diffusæ, ut ut tumultuetur Satan cum suis : ac proinde summo jure de ecclesiæ catholicæ nomine,

page.notes: The first paragraph opens on an indent, so it does not continue from the previous page. "omnibꝰ" uses the -us sign as printed. "cętera" is read from a damaged letter, the cedilla form may be a ç. "ꝓvidentiâ" and "oēs" are read as printed; the p-stroke and the macron are faint on the scan. "ut ut" is printed twice. The left strip showing another page's margin and the marks at the edge are not part of this page.
